items.title: Corporate India posts 25% profit surge in Q4 FY26, but rising costs squeeze margins
items.description: Corporate India's March quarter net profit surged 25.3%, driven by non-operating factors, masking operating challenges like rising input costs that squeezed margins. While FY27 outlook is positive with infrastructure focus, risks include commodity inflation and geopolitical issues. Sector-specific performance is expected, with metals and energy poised for growth.
